candidates.title: [Compatibility] Qwen3.6 MoE CT INT4 checkpoint stores a packed `shared_expert_gate`, but vLLM expects `weight`
candidates.snippet: `mattbucci/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-AWQ-CT` stores `shared_expert_gate` as packed INT4 tensors. The native vLLM model registers a floating-point `weight` for that layer. In a single-layer CPU test, the loader raised a `ValueError` when it received `weight_packed`.  `shared_expert_gate` controls the contribution of the shared expert.
